rules.description: The Grievance Redressal Mechanism must be configured to automatically route registered grievances to the concerned authority.
rules.condition: When a grievance is registered through the portal.
rules.outcome: The grievance is automatically routed to the concerned authority.
rules.evidence_quote: NIC will suitably configure the Grievance Redressal Mechanism available on the portal so that grievances registered through it will be automatically routed to the concerned authority.
